intro: This function is part of a DataSHIELD UTILITY package: it runs on the
analyst's side but is neither a client wrapper for a server function
nor server code. Such packages help the analyst, e.g. set up an
analysis project, create mock data or manage packages. Some of their
functions work on DataSHIELD connections (a `datasources` argument or
DSI::datashield.* calls), others only on local files. When documenting:

param: for a `datasources` argument or a server-side object name,
say that it refers to DataSHIELD connections or an object on the
server; paths and other arguments are plain local R values.
return: describe what is returned in R, and name the files or
folders the function creates or changes, if any.
details: describe side effects on the analyst's machine (files
written, packages installed, projects opened). Never write
'Server function called' — utility functions are not client
examples: examples must not write into the user's home or working
directory: use tempdir() for paths, and pass arguments that keep
the function from opening a new RStudio project or session.
